name: Seismic Smash rank 1 is a Mountainking talent, not a trainer purchase (#7555)
contract: CharacterAdvancement entry 7498 (class type 31, tab 91 = ChrSpecs 60 WILDWALKER/MOUNTAINKING) has
RankSpell 300693, TalentEssenceCost 1 and a 23 TE tab investment requirement, so Seismic Smash rank 1 is
a deep Mountainking talent. 300693 is the only AscensionCompatData::ClassSpells candidate that is also a
TE-paid advancement entry (15 further overlaps all cost 0 TE), and rev_20261027_61 briefly sold it at
trainer 900031 and granted it at level 59. A Wildwalker who knows 300693 with nothing invested in tab 91
holds an untraversible entry set, so every known-entries upload for that tab is refused with
activates. Ranks 2-4 (301276-301279) keep their own trainer rows and their ReqAbility1 gate on 300693,
which the talent grants. This proves the trainer never offers rank 1, that no level grants it, that rank
2 stays gated while rank 1 is unknown, and that activating specialization 60 still works.
